name: AUTONOMAD
description: Search live availability and book real flights, hotels, activities, and events directly from Claude. Autonomad covers ~2 million hotels, hundreds of airlines, and hundreds of thousands of activities and live events worldwide. When you pick something, Claude hands you a single autonomad.ai deep-link to complete payment securely — your card details and identity verification never touch the chat. The first booking unlocks a free 1-month Autonomad Premium trial automatically.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AUTONOMAD to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AUTONOMAD to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.autonomad.ai/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AUTONOMAD MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AUTONOMAD provides these MCP tools: search_hotels, search_flights, search_transport, search_dining, search_activities, search_events, create_booking_intent, and get_capabilities.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AUTONOMAD?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AUTONOMAD in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and Skimetric.
AUTONOMAD does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
AUTONOMAD is developed by AUTONOMAD. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
